basis: Celsius’s May 6 release establishes that Q1 2025 consolidated GAAP revenue was $329,276,000, down 7.43% from $355,708,000 in Q1 2024 and below the $337,922,600 cutoff. The earliest disclosure date remains unresolved. I located the webcast link for the March 18 Roth fireside chat and confirmed that the session began, but could not recover management’s remarks. The upper_bound field records the verified May 6 actual.

coverage.detail: November 6, preceding earnings cycle. The Q3 2024 release attributed revenue weakness to distributor inventory reductions. It gave no Q1 2025 consolidated revenue ceiling.
The November 6 deck distinguished retail sales growth from the effect of distributor inventories on reported Q3 revenue. It supplied no qualifying Q1 forecast.
On the Q3 call, the possible $15 million adjustment arose in a question about Q4 2024 North America sales. Both the quarter and geographic scope differ.

December 3 Morgan Stanley chat, third-party transcript. Toby David said Celsius had yet to give direction for 2025. His discussion of Q1 and Q2 inventory pullbacks concerned 2024. The listed host replay at https://event.webcasts.com/starthere.jsp?ei=1698416&tp_key=4cd44f34f3&tp_special=8 returned a cache miss.
February 7. The 8-K identifies the image-based exhibits as a derivative-action settlement notice and agreement. The monetary disclosure concerned legal fees.
February 20, immediately preceding earnings release. Celsius reported Q4 and full-year 2024 results and announced the Alani Nu agreement. It gave no numeric Q1 2025 consolidated revenue outlook.

February 20 earnings call. Management discussed weak early retail scans, the prior-year Essentials launch, promotion timing and distributor incentives. It gave no explicit upper bound for Q1 consolidated revenue.
February 20 acquisition deck. The approximately $2 billion combined sales figure used 2024 pro forma sales.
February 21 CAGNY deck. The financial comparison used 2024 sales and acquisition synergies. It gave no Q1 2025 consolidated sales ceiling.

Recovered the CAGNY presentation remarks and public Q&A in a third-party transcript. Fieldly explicitly tied $2 billion to the companies’ combined 2024 pro forma sales. The closing question concerned acquisition EPS accretion.
March 10 issuer notice. Celsius invited investors to the March 12 UBS and March 18 Roth webcasts. It scheduled Roth for 3:30 p.m. ET and intended to keep replays available for at least 90 days.
The March 11 event reported in the March 12 filing was expiration of the Alani Nu antitrust waiting period. It supplied no sales update.
Celsius’s event page dates the UBS chat March 12 at 9 a.m. ET. Its webcast target, https://event.webcasts.com/starthere.jsp?ei=1711322&tp_key=fd4cf2909d&tp_special=8, returned a cache miss.

The readable UBS transcript records management describing Q1 comparison pressure from launches moving from January to April and promotions shifting toward late Q1 and Q2. Management gave no numeric consolidated Q1 revenue ceiling.

Roth’s consumer-track flyer lists Celsius. The host’s https://www.roth.com/oc2025 was inaccessible in this review. Its conference portal at https://www.meetmax.com/sched/event_111373/conference_home.html returned “Invalid Event ID: 111373.”

The March 18, 3:30 p.m. ET Roth entry links directly to the SummitCast session below. The issuer archive request at https://ir.celsiusholdingsinc.com/events-and-presentations/default.aspx?Year=2025 did not return the historical listing.

The session-specific webcast request returned a cache miss. The base player at https://event.summitcast.com/view/YsA9Ty4sRyad4m3F6KNZ7x returned zero readable lines. Neither yielded audio, slides or a transcript.
The archive lookup for that exact session URL was inaccessible. Whether an archived recording exists remains unknown.

The March 18 transcript preview confirms Roth analyst Sean McGowan introduced Celsius’s Toby David. Subscriber access begins before management’s remarks. The alternate index at https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/celh/transcripts/ yielded no Roth entry.
Celsius closed the Alani Nu acquisition April 1, after the March 31 quarter end. Alani Nu contributed no revenue to the reported Q1 total.
May 1 scheduling notice announced a May 6 premarket release and 8 a.m. ET call. It supplied no preliminary revenue figure.
May 6 actuals. The issuer release and SEC Exhibit 99.1 show consolidated revenue of 329,276 and 355,708, in thousands of dollars, for the three months ended March 31, 2025 and 2024, respectively.

publication_date_evidence: The earnings release is datelined May 6, 2025 and says Celsius reported its first-quarter results that day. This verifies the publication date of the actual. The unrecovered March 18 management remarks prevent certifying the earliest qualifying disclosure.
